dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Since the wicked dragon is here, why didn't it start feasting on the spot?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Instant gratification has no place in the aesthetics of a wicked dragon! First comes expectation, and then comes patience! Once a dragon's yearning for golden dreams has reached its peak..."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "...Ah, then would the taste of those dreams not be splendid beyond compare?"
